entities.name: Zoltán Szilády
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zoltán Szilády was a Hungarian museologist, entomologist and university lecturer and teacher. He specialised in Diptera. He was born in Budapest and died aged 68 in Grosspösna, Germany.
